hawking_model.interpretation: Fermi-normalised analytic Standard-Model Hawking/QCD approximation. The normalisation bracket spans 25--45 percent around the 35 percent baseline photon-energy fraction considered by Fermi-LAT; it is a model bracket, not a confidence interval.
hawking_model.spectrum_source: Fermi-LAT Collaboration 2018, ApJ 857 49, arXiv:1802.00100, Appendix A

interpretation: Illustrative quasi-steady Hawking-evaporation translation of integrated 1--100 GeV luminosity through the common incident-E^-2 calibration; not a spectrum-specific or final-burst exclusion.
label: Illustrative quasi-steady evaporating-PBH benchmark
